# GeometricRegularizationLoss

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A loss function component that penalizes deviations from geometric priors (e.g., Euclidean distances, curvature) during graph generation, enforcing spatial consistency. Guides the learning process to produce physically plausible topologies, relevant for embedding spatial constraints in TCC physical layer design.
